Quick asks:

- If you have a >2 point variance on the same competency, add a one-line rationale in the score comments column.
- If you want to object to moving forward, reply-all with a short reason; we can escalate to hiring manager.

Attachments: sam_gupta_scorecard.pdf (combined), resume-sam-gupta.pdf, score-extract.csv (raw scores)

Link: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-scorecards

Thanks —
